title: Daily High-Fidelity Photoreal 3D Game Turing Loop
short_summary: End-to-end daily coordinator skill that fuses the ArchDaily Reference-Grounded 4x-RGSS Multi-View Three.js Turing Test Swarm, the 10-Second Toy-First Deterministic 3D Browser Game stack, and the Vamsi AAA Living Game Dossier Laws (Racing, FPS, RTS, and Universal Image-to-Working-Model) to build a high-fidelity photorealistic 3D game each day. Use when creating a daily photoreal 3D web game, racing simulator, tactical FPS, medieval RTS, or playable 3D diorama grounded in reference photography with multi-camera Turing parity, 400% macro-crop critics, CSPRNG double-blind A/B juries, and 60fps instanced WebGL rendering. Don't use for static 2D UI mockups (use jason-design-agent or jason-dev-agent).
